scope: Free, no-account, permitted VIX/VIXW options quotes: actual contract identifiers, bid/ask, quoted sizes, quote timestamps and usable contract terms. Current feed and historical samples evaluated separately.
outcome: No qualifying recurring feed or multi-session VIX quote history established in this bounded scan.

sources.name: MarketData anonymous historical API
sources.observation: Anonymous option endpoint access is documented for AAPL contracts only. Other symbols require authentication. Documented fields include observed bid/ask, sizes and updated timestamp; historical Greeks are not stored.
sources.constraint: No documented anonymous VIX entitlement. No new account created or token requested.

sources.name: Cboe DataShop Option Quote Intervals
sources.category: paid historical/recurring product with public downloadable sample
sources.observation: Product covers ^VIX OPRA options and supplies observed NBBO with sizes, datetime, root, expiration, strike and side. Public sample inspected locally: four September 21, 2023 files contain only AAPL/SPX; February 2, 2022 file contains SPX/SPXW. Zero VIX/VIXW rows across all five CSVs.
sources.constraint: Actual VIX historical/recurring product is purchased, not free. Public sample is not VIX history. No purchase or signup.

sources.name: Cboe DataShop Option EOD Summary
sources.observation: Official product documents 15:45 Eastern and product-dependent end-of-day NBBO snapshots with sizes, covering index options including ^VIX. Historical coverage advertised from 2012.
sources.constraint: No free recurring entitlement established. Public sample link discovered but not downloaded during this scan.

sources.name: HistoricalData.net
sources.observation: VIX root is advertised in archive. Free 239 MB sample is explicitly TSLA, KO, SPY and SPX/SPXW for July-December 2022; no VIX. Examples include sizes and date, but displayed quote_time cells are blank.
sources.constraint: No VIX sample or free recurring VIX entitlement established. Large non-VIX sample not downloaded.

sources.name: DoltHub post-no-preference/options
sources.observation: Documented read-only SQL API accepted anonymous DESCRIBE. Actual table has date, symbol, expiration, strike, call/put, bid, ask and Greeks. No quoted sizes or intraday quote timestamp, volume/OI or contract terms. Bounded SELECT for VIX/^VIX/VIXW/^VIXW timed out; timeout is not proof that roots are absent.
sources.constraint: Schema insufficient for required execution evidence; VIX coverage and redistribution rights not established. No bulk clone.

sources.name: ThetaData
sources.category: authenticated free historical EOD tier and public sample bundle
sources.observation: Free tier offers historical EOD options with one-day delay. Authentication requires API key or email/password. Public no-account sample is described as one day across UTP/CTA stock endpoints; VIX options coverage is not established in that sample.
sources.constraint: No-account condition is not met for normal data access; no executable downloaded or launched.

sources.name: Tallac Options
sources.observation: Official free tier explicitly lists all available VIX option-chain records, and three API requests per minute. Website directs users to register; no anonymous permitted API established.
sources.constraint: Requires membership; current user's no-account instruction preserved. No signup or contact.

sources.name: OptionsDX VIX Option Chains
sources.observation: VIX chain product lists 2010-2023, EOD through 5-minute frequencies, with bid/ask and quote timestamps. Its public sample download is named spy_sample-1.csv, not VIX. Year/frequency selections use cart/checkout; not a recurring current feed.
sources.constraint: No account/checkout performed. Dataset field DTE definition assumes 16:00 expiration generically and must not override actual VIX settlement/last-trade rules.

sources.name: RutgerVER thesis data repository
sources.observation: README describes timestamped VIX BBO with bid/ask sizes. Tree lists April 1, April 8 and July 1, 2025 files. Connector fetch confirms first VIX file is a Git LFS pointer to 47,197,430 bytes. Visible root contains no LICENSE and README does not establish vendor provenance/permission.
sources.constraint: Not adopted due unestablished redistribution rights, contract metadata and evidence quality. No 47 MB data fetched; public availability alone is not a license.

sources.name: Optionwatch
sources.observation: Website advertises VIX chains with free streaming after market-data agreements. No documented no-account automated API or offline export entitlement established.
sources.constraint: No scraping, private API inspection, signup or agreement accepted.

index_signal_sources.permission_scope: Personal non-commercial copy under section2; no raw-data redistribution, no blanket open-data or commercial-use license.
index_signal_sources.usage: Fixed retrospective index signal diagnostics only; no option price/return, paper fill or business deployment entitlement.

not_substitutes: SPX options used to calculate VIX
Black-Scholes or other modeled VIX options quotes
limits: No qualifying free no-account options feed established in this bounded scan.
Public availability is not a redistribution license. No accounts, checkout, agreements, brokers, contacts or paid services were added.
Cboe delayed quote page extraction is prohibited; its hidden/CDN quote APIs are not an allowed fallback.
Index-source raw CSVs and private research artifacts must be excluded from public Git and distributable packages.
